question: What consequence follows if a foolish person touches the forbidden things?
premises: A foolish-minded person may touch the forbidden things
Such contact has a destructive effect
Even the prosperity of Hari is said to be harmed
inference: If a foolish person touches these things, he destroys prosperity, even that of Hari.
uncertainties: The hyperbolic reference to Hari's prosperity emphasizes the severity of the fault.
plain_english: If a foolish person touches them, he destroys prosperity, even that of Hari.
